title: Pursue without catching, raise without striking
odia:
ଗୋଡାଉଥିବୁ ଧରିବୁ ନାଇଁ
ଉଞ୍ଚାଉଥିବୁ ମାରିବୁ ନାଇଁ।
literal_meaning: Keep chasing, but do not catch; keep raising, but do not strike.
meaning_odia: ଗୋଡ଼ାଇବ, କିନ୍ତୁ ଧରିବ ନାହିଁ; ଉଞ୍ଚାଇବ, କିନ୍ତୁ ମାରିବ ନାହିଁ। ଉତ୍ସର ବ୍ୟାଖ୍ୟାରେ ଏହା ପ୍ରକୃତ ଦଣ୍ଡ ନଦେଇ ଭୟ ଦେଖାଇ କାମ ହାସଲ କରିବାର କଥା। ଉଭୟ ଧାଡ଼ିରେ ଆରମ୍ଭ କରାଯାଇଥିବା କ୍ରିୟାର ଶେଷ ପଦକ୍ଷେପକୁ ଅଟକାଇ ରଖାଯାଏ।
explanation: Both lines begin an action and forbid its completion. The inspected gloss presents this as using the display of a threat instead of carrying out punishment. The saying’s tension lies between visible pursuit or preparation and the deliberately withheld act.
usage_example: Original imagined example: In a discussion of a story, a character repeatedly threatens action but stops before carrying it out. A reader quotes the saying to describe that pattern and asks what effect the threats have on others.
cultural_context: The parallel commands give pursuit and a raised gesture the same stopping point. Each line ends in refusal: no catching, no striking. The source treats that gap between threat and action as a method of control; the verse itself names neither a weapon nor a target.

witnesses.note: Rendered upload inspected17November2026. Missing ଞ୍ଚ glyph in second-line opening restored from documented underlying PDF character mapping. Other uploaded spelling and line order retained.

witnesses.locator: ଗ-section130 line1497; reversed-order ଉ-section7 line529, inspected17November2026.
witnesses.note: Public forms use ଗୋଡ଼ାଇଥିବୁ, ଉଞ୍ଚାଇଥିବୁ and ନାହିଁ. ଗ130 gloss explicitly distinguishes displaying threat from executing punishment; no silent spelling harmonisation.

odia_summary: ଭୟ ଦେଖାଇବା ଓ ପ୍ରକୃତ କାର୍ଯ୍ୟ କରିବା ମଧ୍ୟରେ ଉତ୍ସର ଭେଦ।
english_summary: The source distinguishes a displayed threat from carrying it out.
